title: Introduce App Command
description: Add an Introduce App command to the OS command registry and make executing it start the active app introduction from the first step.
summary: Added the localized Introduce App command and corrected the shared introduction/dialog glass overlay to use appearance-adaptive semantic foreground tokens. Primary text now uses text-foreground and secondary text uses text-muted-foreground, with a focused rendered-DOM regression test confirming the adaptive classes.
